evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-22"} returned 201 with "dueDate":"2026-10-22", a date with no time. A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 200 and the date was set. A PATCH with only a title kept the date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate was null.
evidence.AC3: POST /todos returned 400 for each of these dueDate values: "30.02.2026", "2026-02-30", "2026-13-01", "abc" and 123. PATCH with "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-23 (UTC). Test data: one todo due yesterday, one due today, one due in the future, one with no date, and one done todo with a past date. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due yesterday. The today, future, no-date and done-past todos were excluded.
evidence.AC5: The page at / showed each todo's due date in a time element: 22.10.2026, 23.10.2026, 01.12.2026 and 01.01.2026. The todo without a date showed none.
evidence.AC6: On the page, only the todo due yesterday carried the marker "Überfällig". The today, future, no-date and done-past todos had no marker. The word is capitalised at the start of its label, which I accepted as the word "überfällig".
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". Clicking it reduced the list from 5 todos to only "past – 22.10.2026 – Überfällig".
